messages.content: Mix the color #FAEBD7 with #00FFFF, what is the new color?

function.name: get_prophet_details
function.description: Get detailed information about a prophet in a given religion. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

religion.description: The religion that the prophet is associated with.

historical_context.description: Whether or not to include information about the historical context in which the prophet lived. Default is false.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Mix the color #FAEBD7 with #00FFFF, what is the new color?" They want the result of mixing two colors. We need to interpret mixing as averaging the RGB components. So we take hex #FAEBD7 (which is rgb(250, 235, 215)) and #00FFFF (rgb(0,255,255)). Average each component: R: (250+0)/2=125; G: (235+255)/2=245; B: (215+255)/2=235. So average gives rgb(125,245,235). Convert back to hex: 125 decimal is 0x7D; 245 decimal is 0xF5; 235 decimal is 0xEB. So hex #7DF5EB. But check rounding: 125 exactly, 245 exactly, 235 exactly. So #7DF5EB.

But maybe they want to mix by blending equally. Yes. So answer: #7DF5EB.

We should respond with the new color code. Possibly also mention the resulting color name? But likely just give hex. So answer: #7DF5EB.
